title: First Unique Character in a String
statement: Return the index of the first character that occurs exactly once, or -1 if no such character exists.
explanation: Count characters, then scan the string in original order for the first count of one.

title: Longest Absolute File Path
statement: Given a newline- and tab-delimited file-system description, return the longest absolute path length to a file.
explanation: Use tab depth to maintain cumulative directory lengths and identify files by the presence of a dot.

title: Find the Difference
statement: String t is formed by shuffling string s and adding one character. Return the added character.
explanation: XOR all characters from both strings; matching characters cancel and the extra character remains.

title: Elimination Game
statement: Repeatedly remove every other number from a list 1..n, alternating left-to-right and right-to-left, and return the last number.
explanation: Track the first remaining number, the gap between survivors, and the direction of each pass.

title: Is Subsequence
statement: Determine whether s is a subsequence of t by deleting zero or more characters from t without changing order.
explanation: Advance the pointer in s only when the current character of t matches the next needed character.

title: UTF-8 Validation
statement: Validate whether each integer byte sequence follows UTF-8 leading-byte and continuation-byte rules.
explanation: Determine the expected continuation count from the leading byte and verify each following byte starts with 10.

title: Decode String
statement: Decode expressions such as k[encoded_string], where the bracketed string is repeated k times and nesting is allowed.
explanation: Use stacks to save the prior string and repetition count when opening a bracket.

title: Longest Substring with At Least K Repeating Characters
statement: Return the longest substring in which every distinct character occurs at least k times.
explanation: If a character occurs fewer than k times in a region, no valid substring can contain it; split around such characters and recurse.

title: Rotate Function
statement: For array A, maximize F(k)=sum(i*A_k[i]) over all cyclic rotations.
explanation: Compute F(0) and total sum, then use F(k)=F(k-1)+sum(A)-n*A[n-k].

title: Integer Replacement
statement: Find the minimum operations to reduce positive integer n to 1 by halving even values or adding/subtracting one from odd values.
explanation: For odd values, prefer the adjustment that creates more trailing zeros, except 3 is handled by decrementing.
